name: mapping_null_value_becomes_empty_string
description: put stores an explicit JSON null. src/provider/mod.rs Value::from_json_at maps serde_json::Value::Null to Value::String(String::new()) unconditionally — the daemon's cache has no null representation, so a put null is documented, verified behavior: it comes back as an empty string with data_type "string", not "null". This is genuinely surprising and every binding must agree on it rather than each guessing independently (e.g. surfacing it as a native null/None/nil).
